original_test_intent: Verify amdgpu is loaded and all eight expected AMD GPUs are visible in amd-smi at the exact source-defined BDFs without unexplained driver/PCIe errors.
original_method: Agent collects complete amd-smi list, module state, per-BDF PCI driver binding and OS/BMC error logs, then produces an eight-device comparison.
manual_activity: No physical action is required; engineer reviews any inventory/binding/error discrepancy and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Expected device count and UUID interpretation policy
Secure read-only access and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify host and AMD-SMI tool identity
Preserve complete outputs/status and baseline logs
Correlate every BDF to bound amdgpu driver
Stop on missing/extra/unbound/malformed device, driver/AER/kernel/thermal/power/BMC error
Do not reload/reset/update or clear evidence
agent_execution_scope: Run amd-smi list and capture all records
Collect module and per-BDF driver binding plus supporting PCI inventory
Compare exact eight-device topology and errors
Do not rely on generic counts, mutate devices or issue DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm baseline/tool versions and UUID expectations
Review complete comparison and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lsmod and generic lspci are supporting evidence only; they do not execute the literal amd-smi list or prove every exact BDF is visible and bound.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run complete `amd-smi list`, then verify module state and sysfs/lspci driver binding for each of the eight explicit BDFs with error logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight source GPU indices/BDF records, amd-smi list, driver-visible intent and source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a strict one-row-per-expected-BDF inventory/binding/UUID comparison and flag missing, extra or erroneous devices.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds binding and log proof without altering the read-only source check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic accelerator presence is not counted as exact amd-smi visibility.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The repeated placeholder-like UUIDs in source may require project interpretation; BDF identity remains the primary explicit topology.

project_override_considerations: Project authority may clarify the source Criteria typo and UUID expectations, but the explicit eight BDFs and driver visibility may not be weakened or inferred away.
expected_evidence: Exact command, exit status and complete eight-device list
amdgpu module and sysfs/PCI driver binding per BDF
dmesg/syslog/SEL, thermal/power status and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Despite a grammatical Criteria defect, title, Procedure and explicit expected inventory consistently require all eight devices visible and bound; no competing method is present.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AMD-SMI and expected topology are explicit/supplyable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Moves from generic class/module presence to an exact eight-device amd-smi and binding audit with error evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A loaded amdgpu module does not prove it bound every GPU, and PCI class enumeration does not prove the management stack recognizes them. Each explicit BDF must appear in amd-smi and show the correct driver binding; otherwise one failed GPU can be hidden by unrelated accelerators or a globally loaded module.
